summary: Market is in consolidation mode 2 weeks before spot ETF deadline. BTC stuck at monthly resistance 44-47k with no clear swing setup until post-ETF. Weekly support at 41.8-43k is key short-term level. ETH underperforming significantly, stuck at 0.055-0.057 ETH/BTC and $2.1k support. Altcoin speculation elevated by open interest metrics, especially in memecoins, creating potential liquidation cascade risk. Best strategy is to wait for ETF event resolution before high-timeframe swing trading.
